Connected speech

C

🔊 4 How many words can you hear in each of these sentences? Contractions (such as he’ll, isn’t, etc.) count as two words.

Audio script
  1. We’ll discuss it over lunch. (We + will · discuss · it · over · lunch = 6)
  2. I’ll get straight to the point. (I + will · get · straight · to · the · point = 7)
  3. They’ll put me in the picture, won’t they? (They + will · put · me · in · the · picture · will + not · they = 10)
  4. I’m afraid we’re going to have to let you go. (I + am · afraid · we + are · going · to · have · to · let · you · go = 12)
Tip
To practise saying a sentence faster, start from the end, like this:
  • over lunch
  • discuss it over lunch
  • We’ll discuss it over lunch.

🔊 4 Practise saying each sentence like this, using the audio script. Then listen to the recording again.
